⚠ INSTRUMENT LESSON, measured here: `read_text` reads WebDriver's rendered text, which applies `text-transform`. `.tag` is uppercase in BOTH the mockup and the ship, so a copy pin through read_text measures PRESENTATION, not the string. The rendered form is pinned here (it is what the user sees); the mockup-verbatim SOURCE bytes are pinned in design_polish.rs, which is where character-for-character pins belong.

steps.literal: Create a one-time invite code and send it to the person you want to add — by text, email, or in person. Anyone who has the code can connect to you once, so share it through a channel you trust.

steps.text: Z2 — the no-relay gate. A fresh profile has relay_url == "" (measured), so Create cannot succeed and is DISABLED rather than left to fail.

steps.literal: Set a relay address in Settings → Relay before creating an invite.

steps.text: Z1 — the second entry. It exists so the flow stays reachable once the welcome pane is gone.
Refresh-on-open: the gate re-reads the relay configuration when the modal OPENS. No timer was added and none was needed.

Z2 — the create arm. ⚠ ≥10s tolerance is MEASURED, not guessed: an unreachable .test relay costs two failed network calls (the pre-clamp relay_server_info, bounded at 10s, then the create POST) and was driven at 4112 ms.

R380 §2 option (A): BOTH provenances named. relay_send_outcome_from_parts returns the caller's fallback for every non-TLS failure, so unreachable and refused arrive as the SAME code (relay_rejected, driven). Claiming 'couldn't reach the relay' here would be unmeasured.

steps.literal: The relay didn't create the invite
Nothing was created — the relay couldn't be reached, or it refused the request. Check Settings → Relay; its Test connection button can tell which.
